title: seguir + -ando, es probable que, gratis, empezar a / empezar -ando, terminar de / terminar -ando

cards.title: seguir + -ando = keep doing
cards.body: 'It's probable that he continues' is how Spanish says 'he'll probably carry on'.

cards.title: gratis = free (of charge)
cards.body: Linked to English 'gratuitous'. The -ing of ser is siendo.

examples.en: It's essential that it stays free.
examples.es: Es imperativo que siga siendo gratis.

cards.title: empezar / comenzar a + 'to' form
cards.body: Apart from movement verbs, a handful of verbs need a preposition to join the next verb.

examples.en: It's amazing that they're starting to speak Spanish.
examples.es: Es espectacular que comiencen a hablar español.

cards.title: empezar + -ando = start out doing
cards.body: With -ing the meaning shifts to 'start out doing it from the beginning', with no a.

examples.en: … that they start out speaking Spanish.
examples.es: Es espectacular que comiencen hablando español.

cards.title: terminar de = finish doing
cards.body: Two mood tenses: after quiero que, and after cuando (future).

examples.en: I want you to talk to me when you finish selling them.
examples.es: Quiero que hablen conmigo cuando terminen de venderlos.

cards.title: terminar + -ando = end up doing
cards.body: A verb that joins with a preposition may also take -ing with a different meaning.

examples.en: … when you end up selling them.
examples.es: Quiero que hablen conmigo cuando terminen vendiéndolos.

cards.title: Learn it by noticing
cards.body: The vowel changes are hard to hear at first. Chatting online in writing lets you spot each a or e swap and work out why it was used.
